post_clip.description: Two individuals suddenly drop/collapse to the ground without physical contact or visible cause (frames 0:57–1:00), consistent with reaction to gunfire; a third person nearby also reacts abruptly and moves away. No visible weapon, but the sudden, unprovoked collapse and panic behavior strongly indicate a shooting event.
